args.name: file name for save_as, template name for template

tools.description: Manages your to-do list (stored locally): add a task, list tasks, mark one done, remove one.

args.action: add, list, done, remove or clear_done
args.item: The task text, or which task (number, first/last, or words)

tools.description: List the programs using the most RAM right now.

Find a control by role/name/ordinal in the window, web page, IDE or phone screen and click it, tick it, type into it, read it or scroll - never by coordinates.

args.action: click | check | uncheck | type | read | find | scroll | select | slider | expand | collapse | menu | modal | explain | focus | next_focus | clear | copy | remove_attachment
args.target: control description: 'the send button', 'search box', 'the second result'
args.window: window/app the control is in (default: the one in front)
args.approved: owner already approved a consequential control

tools.description: Uninstalls an installed application (via winget). Always asks for confirmation first.

args.name: Name of the installed application to remove

tools.description: Updates one application, or all applications with available updates, using winget.

args.name: Application to update; empty = update everything that has updates

tools.description: Control the video/audio the owner is watching: play, pause, seek to a time or by seconds, speed, volume, mute, captions, full screen, next, skip a skippable ad, report position.

args.action: play | pause | toggle | seek_to | seek_by | rate | mute | unmute | volume | restart | next | previous | captions | fullscreen | skip_ad | loop | state
args.value: seconds for seek, rate for speed, 0-100 for volume
args.relative: rate is a step up/down from the current speed

tools.description: Performs voice-driven editing on active text: backspace, delete word, delete sentence, undo, redo, select, replace X with Y, capitalize, lowercase, copy, cut, paste, mixed.

args.action: Voice edit action: backspace, delete_word, delete_sentence, undo, redo, select_sentence, replace, capitalize, lowercase, copy, cut, paste, mixed

tools.description: Read the current master speaker volume percentage.
Set the master speaker volume to an exact percentage (0-100).
Greet the user and show the JARVIS dashboard.
Checks wake word engine and detection status. Risk level: READ_ONLY.
Start, list or cancel a scoped, time-limited watch: skip ads when the Skip button appears (this video only), tell when a download finishes, tell when the IDE agent is done.

args.action: skip_ads | download_done | ide_done | when | cancel | list
args.condition: for when: download_done | file_appears | window_opened | window_closed | phone_connected | battery_below | battery_above | control_appears | control_enabled | ide_done | page_changed | task_done | captcha | whatsapp_message
args.subject: what the condition is about: window/app, file name, control, task
args.then: the owner's own follow-up command, run through JARVIS when it happens
args.notify_phone: also post the notice on the owner's phone
args.kind: watch kind for cancel (skip_ad, download, ide)
args.minutes: how long the watch may run

tools.description: Uses the browser with AI to complete a multi-step web goal (search sites, open results, read pages, fill forms with dropdowns and checkboxes) and reports the result. Pauses for the user to log in (then continues), and stops before payments or purchases.

args.goal: What to achieve on the web, e.g. 'find the price of Sony WH-1000XM5 on Amazon'
args.resume: Continue the previous web task from the current page (e.g. after the user logged in)

tools.description: Controls WhatsApp bridge connectivity: connect, disconnect, or request new pairing code. Risk level: REVERSIBLE.

args.action: Action: connect, disconnect, pair, status

tools.description: Turns WhatsApp auto-reply on for one contact, several, or all direct contacts for a limited time (never groups), turns it off, or reports its status. Replies use the owner's style with each person.

args.action: enable, disable, disable_all or status
args.who: Contact name, number, JID, or her/him/them
args.everyone: All DIRECT contacts (groups are always excluded)
args.window_text: Original wording with the duration / end time
args.note: What to tell people (away message), if the owner said it
args.exclude: People left out of an everyone-grant, comma separated

tools.description: Learns the owner's texting style for each person from chat files dropped into data/whatsapp_feed (WhatsApp export .txt/.zip, WhatsApp Web copy, Telegram/Instagram/Chat Exporter JSON, CSV, 'Name: message' transcripts). One-to-one chats only; each file is imported once.
Focus, maximize, minimize, restore, full-screen, close or arrange windows by description (previous window, my editor, chrome with YouTube), with foreground history.

args.action: focus | maximize | minimize | restore | fullscreen | close | arrange | list | resize | move | active | find | info | save_layout | restore_layout | isolate (minimise every other window)
args.target: window description: 'previous', 'my editor', 'chrome', 'second chrome', a title word
args.layout: left | right | top | bottom | side_by_side | stack | quadrants | center | next_monitor
args.launch: open the app first if no window of it is open
args.direction: resize: smaller | bigger; move: left | right | other
args.name: layout name for save_layout / restore_layout

tools.description: Owner-authored workflows: save a named list of commands, preview it, run it (each step goes through JARVIS normally and the run stops at the first failure), clone, enable, disable, schedule or cancel a schedule.

args.action: run | preview | create | clone | enable | disable | schedule | cancel_schedule | list | run_at | trigger | list_triggers | cancel_trigger
args.name: workflow name
args.steps: create: the owner's own commands, in order
args.override: run: a folder to use instead of the one in the saved steps
args.command: run_at / trigger: the owner's own command to run later
args.condition: trigger: app_opened | app_closed | phone_connected | phone_disconnected | battery_below | battery_above | download_done
args.subject: trigger: the app name for app_opened / app_closed
args.ref: cancel_trigger: which one (a word from its command, its number, or empty)
